citation: Kaga H, Tamura Y, Takeno K, et al. Higher C-Peptide Level During Glucose Clamp Is Associated With Muscle Insulin Resistance in Nonobese Japanese Men. Journal of the Endocrine Society. 2019.
protocol: Two-step hyperinsulinaemic euglycaemic clamp after overnight fast: step 1 primed + 10 mU/m2/min insulin for 3 h, step 2 priming + higher infusion (80 mU/m2 priming; rate per Methods); preceded by 75 g OGTT visits
population: n=49 nonobese Japanese men, age median 40 (IQR 36-45) y, BMI 23.1+/-1.0 (split into Low and High steady-state serum C-peptide groups, n=25/24)
note: Two-step clamp with EGP, Rd and FFA suppression in one table. Overall and per-group columns. Some rows are median (IQR).
